{{Quote|There's still a chance to save Han! At the east&mdash; platform! |[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''East Platform''' was a landing platform in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] landed here when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] came to retrieve the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-encased [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].
